Our Team. Our Passion. Our Approach. Primary Responsibilities Include Design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality distributed applications within the FORTNA Warehouse Execution System (WES) platform. Participate in the architecture, design, implementation, and delivery of scalable warehouse automation and execution solutions. Collaborate with Product, QA, Infrastructure, and Services teams to deliver reliable and maintainable software solutions. Provide remote support, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis for both new WES solutions and legacy WCS systems. Contribute to system reliability, performance optimization, scalability, observability, and operational excellence. Develop and maintain RESTful APIs, event-driven integrations, microservices, and enterprise application components. Assist QA and Infrastructure teams in test automation, deployment validation, packaging, and release activities. Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices, coding standards, and technical documentation. Support project customization efforts and assist implementation teams during customer deployments. Continuously learn and adopt new technologies, tools, and engineering practices, including AI-assisted software development tools. Share technical knowledge with team members and actively contribute to continuous improvement initiatives. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 5+ years of professional software development experience. Strong experience with Java (Java 17 or later preferred) and concurrent/distributed application development. Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Analysis and Design (OOAD), software design patterns, and clean coding principles. Experience developing enterprise applications using modern Java frameworks and technologies (e.g., Spring Boot, Quarkus, Play Framework, Micronaut, or similar), including RESTful APIs and distributed systems. Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, or MySQL. Experience with messaging technologies, event-driven architectures, or message brokers (Kafka, NATS, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, IBM MQ, etc.). Experience with Git and modern build tools such as Maven or Gradle. Experience working with Docker and containerized applications. Familiarity with Linux-based development and deployment environments. Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and problem-solving skills. Good written and verbal English communication skills. Ability to work effectively in Agile/Scrum development environments. Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration platforms. Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, ELK, OpenSearch, Splunk, or Datadog. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices. Experience with warehouse automation, warehouse execution systems (WES), warehouse control systems (WCS), logistics, supply chain, or industrial automation domains. Experience working with AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar developer productivity tools. Experience participating in technical design discussions, mentoring junior engineers, and driving engineering improvements.
